elements.description: Surface app bar with directional Back action, DATA SEARCH eyebrow, title, and Sources action.
Cyan space chip directly below the app-bar row shows the selected existing space and opens space selection.
Decorative cyan search glyph beside the dashboard introduction.
Localized Search this space heading and explanation that safe indexed sources provide excerpts.
Permanently labelled query field scoped to the selected space.
Filled Search action enabled only when an indexed source and knowledge-read access exist.
Add text tile explains that UTF-8 text becomes a file source.
Choose file tile explicitly opens the Android system document picker.
Three written readiness counters distinguish searchable, safety-check, and indexing groups.
Recent sources list uses one full-width target per source.
Every recent-source card contains separate File safety and Search index status rows.
Empty or no-indexed-source state explains why search is unavailable and offers permitted add paths.
Offline, permission-denied, and session-expired variants hide unauthorized content and provide a safe exit.
Expanded layout retains app navigation with Data Search visibly selected by label, icon, and container.
App bar with Back, Add text title, and selected-space chip.
Localized Add text as a file heading.
Explanation that Android prepares UTF-8 text/plain bytes and uses the normal file pipeline.
Persistent Source file name label.
Outlined source-file-name field with a text-file example and no invented server limit.
Persistent Content label.
Multiline text field that grows or scrolls and remains reachable with the IME.
Supporting text states that accepted MIME types and size limits still need working-backend confirmation.
Draft retention and upload-recovery decision note is visible without claiming behavior.
Outlined Cancel action precedes the primary action in reading order.
Filled Add and index action is disabled until local form validation succeeds.
Submitting variant shows distinct local preparation, registration, byte upload, safety scan, readiness, and indexing steps.
Quarantined, failed, offline, permission, and session variants never turn an unknown stage into success.
App bar with Back, Sources title, Add source action, and selected-space chip.
Localized Source library heading.
Supporting text states that file safety and search indexing are separate.
Scrollable unified source list joins file and document data by file_id rather than name.
Indexed source row shows safe-and-ready plus indexed-and-searchable as separate written statuses.
Scanning source row shows safety check in progress and indexing not started.
Failed-index source row shows a safe file and a failed index without a raw server reason.
Paging note says file pages and document-status pages have independent cursors.
Expanded trailing pane asks the user to choose a source until a row is selected.
Empty state explains that no files exist in the selected space and offers an allowed add path.
Offline and partial-read variants retain only confirmed content and identify the unresolved side.
Permission and session variants hide names and status data and expose only a safe next action.
App bar with Back, Source details title, and selected-space chip.
Decorative source-type glyph in a cyan container.
Localized source file name and source-type eyebrow.
File safety panel independently renders uploaded, scanning, safe-and-ready, or quarantined.
Quarantine notice states that the file cannot be indexed or searched.
Search index panel independently renders not-started, pending, indexing, indexed, or failed.
Failed-index supporting text avoids a raw reason because DocumentOut does not publish one.
Source information panel shows confirmed kind, size, and update data from FileOut.
Start indexing is enabled only for a safe ready file with manage access and no live document.
Search this space is enabled only when the source is indexed.
Delete file and index is a full-width danger action shown only with actual file-delete access.
Offline, permission, and session variants reconcile or hide state instead of retrying mutations blindly.
App bar with Back, Searching title, and selected-space chip.
Localized Searching this space heading.
Persistent localized query label.
Read-only outlined field preserves the active query.
Cyan progress indicator has an accessible searching label.
Text says the search uses indexed sources in the selected space.
Contract note explains top-k behavior and that there is no cursor pagination.
No-indexed-source variant routes to sources instead of starting a fake search.
Offline variant states that no new search starts.
Permission and session variants hide the query and provide a safe action.
App bar with Back, Results title, and selected-space chip.
Localized Top search results heading and source-excerpt explanation.
Permanently labelled query field retains the current query.
Filled Search action reruns the query in the same selected space.
Top 5 matches label reflects the documented default k without claiming a total.
Result list contains source-linked excerpts in returned relevance order.
Result with metadata shows excerpt, file_name, page number, and section when non-null.
Result with null page or section states that metadata is unavailable rather than inventing it.
Contract note says excerpts are not a generated answer and score is not displayed.
Empty state suggests changing words and explicitly avoids next-page controls.
Offline, permission, and session variants do not expose cached excerpts as authorization.
Expanded layout uses navigation rail and a wide result surface without changing reading order.
App bar with Back, Search excerpt title, and selected-space chip.
Localized Source eyebrow.
File name or a generic source label when file_name is null.
Page and section metadata appear only when returned by the search contract.
Localized Matched excerpt section heading.
Quoted RetrievedChunk text with a non-color-only highlighted query match.
Notice clarifies that only context returned by search is shown and no score or IDs are exposed.
Open source details action is shown only when the result can be mapped safely to a visible source.
Permission and session variants immediately hide the excerpt.
Modal scrim obscures the source-details surface while preserving context.
Error-container delete glyph identifies destructive intent without relying on color alone.
Dialog title includes the file name and asks for irreversible deletion confirmation.
Body says the file leaves reads and its documents, chunks, and search index are purged.
Guard text says the row remains until the service confirms deletion.
Cancel is the initial-focus safe action.
Delete file and index is an explicit danger action and never announces success early.
App bar with directional Back, DATA SEARCH eyebrow, and Choose a space title; no selected-space chip.
Localized Choose a space heading.
Supporting text says files, indexes, and searches belong to one existing space.
Cursor-paginated list contains only existing accessible spaces.
Each full-row space target shows name, confirmed file count, and confirmed bytes used.
Load more spaces requests the next cursor page without creating or managing a space.
Review note states that creation, rename, and deletion are outside this flow.
No-space variant blocks entry and explains that Data Search needs an existing space.
No-space Refresh retries the read and Return home remains available through Back.
Offline, permission, and session variants never expose stale space names as authorization.
Modal scrim obscures the add-source surface before registration begins.
Replacement glyph in an error container marks a potentially destructive collision.
Dialog asks whether to replace the older live file with the same normalized name.
Body says completing the upload may replace the older file and purge its index.
Best-effort warning states that a concurrent upload can still create a collision after the client check.
Cancel receives initial focus and starts no registration or upload.
Continue and replace is an explicit danger action that proceeds to registration only after confirmation.
